title: Oven Broiled Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A citrusy and energizing Syrian dish featuring chicken breast, rapeseed oil, and a blend of spices, served in a molcajete vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together rapeseed oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a molcajete vessel or on a broiler pan.
Broil the chicken kebabs in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the chicken kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Repeat the cooking process for any remaining skewers.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving.
